Mumbai and Delhi face heavy rains, disrupting transport and daily life

Heavy rainfall has impacted several parts of India, with Mumbai experiencing significant disruptions to its train services and waterlogging. The city's water stock has also seen an increase due to the downpour. Meanwhile, Delhi also reported waterlogging issues, affecting commuters. A viral post from Mumbai highlighted the recurring challenges faced during monsoon season.
